title: LLM Inference and Architecture Notes
description: Chapter-based notes covering LLM inference (prefill/decode, KV cache, cross-model KV transfer, memory, bandwidth, GPU sizing, quantization) and modern transformer architecture (GPT-2 → Kimi K3, attention variants, CoPE, KDA, LoRA, distillation) and JEPA representation learning (I-JEPA, stopgrad, EMA). Use the chapters array for sequential reading or the topics index for lookup by concept.

chapters.title: Glossary: Abbreviations, Symbols, and Terms
chapters.summary: Reference tables for all abbreviations, symbols, math signs, and the operations-bytes-intensity-time relationships used throughout the other chapters.

chapters.title: Inference Overview: Prefill vs Decode, Compute vs Memory
chapters.summary: The two-phase model (prefill, decode), the four-quadrant bottleneck table, compute-bound vs memory-bound definitions, the prefill/decode side-by-side comparison, and the compact mental model.

chapters.title: Prefill and Decode Mechanics
chapters.summary: Why prefill is compute-bound and decode is memory-bound, how the KV cache changes the trade-off, the exact prompt-to-autoregressive-decode lifecycle, how subword/byte tokenization generates names absent as whole vocabulary tokens, and the 7B FP16 worked example.

chapters.title: Batching, Scheduling, and vLLM
chapters.summary: Why batching helps decode, continuous batching and vLLM internals, plus detailed PagedAttention and KV-block allocation: fragmentation, logical-to-physical block tables, address translation, numerical allocation, why Python's apparent automatic growth does not resize GPU tensors freely, free lists versus prefix hashes, prefill/decode lifecycle, block-size tradeoffs, and related optimizations.

chapters.title: Memory Planning: Weights, KV Cache, and Runtime
chapters.summary: GB vs GiB units, the P × s_w weight formula, the 2·N_l·N_kv·d_h·s_kv per-token KV-cache formula, MHA vs GQA vs MQA, the 8B-class GQA worked example, and the full VRAM planning equation (weights + KV + activations + runtime + headroom).

chapters.title: Compute and FLOPs
chapters.summary: Why matrix multiplication costs ≈2mkn FLOPs, why a dense LLM costs ≈2P FLOPs per token, prefill/decode FLOPs formulas, the VRAM-to-compute memory hierarchy (HBM → L2 → shared memory → registers), the 438 MB-per-layer illustration, and CUDA cores vs Tensor Cores.

chapters.title: Bandwidth, Arithmetic Intensity, and the Roofline
chapters.summary: Memory bandwidth vs FLOP/s, the GPU ops:byte ratio, the small-processor worked example (A/B/C workloads), the H100 295 FLOP/byte example, how batching and quantization shift intensity, and how FLOPs/byte bounds the number of users served.

chapters.title: Choosing a GPU Systematically
chapters.summary: 8-step procedure (define workload → read config → check VRAM → check prefill compute → check decode bandwidth → check software → check multi-GPU → benchmark), how inference engineers use architecture knowledge for model selection, the GPU-property priority table, and the compact sizing worksheet.

chapters.title: Quantization
chapters.summary: Why quantization speeds up decode (bytes transferred per parameter), the FP32/FP16/FP8/INT8/INT4 table, the two caveats (metadata overhead, KV cache is separate), and how quantization shifts the roofline.

chapters.title: From GPT-2 to Kimi K3
chapters.summary: The original article by @waterloo_intern tracing the architectural evolution: GPT-2 → Linear Attention → DeltaNet → Gated DeltaNet → KDA → Kimi Linear → Kimi K3, plus AttnRes and the MoE details.

chapters.title: Modern Attention: MHA to KDA
chapters.summary: Companion notes: Q/K/V intuition, multi-head reshaping, detailed absolute/relative/RoPE mathematics, and a complete CoPE reference covering tensor shapes, learned gate-key projections, a numerical sigmoid-gate example, contextual-position matrices, pmax, efficient QE interpolation, training, gate variants and their KV-cache tradeoffs, prefill/decode execution, complexity, empirical scope, and limitations; followed by MHA/MQA/GQA/MLA, FlashAttention, linear attention, KDA, hybrid attention, and architecture selection.

chapters.title: Training and Adaptation: LoRA, QLoRA, Distillation
chapters.summary: Companion notes: LoRA (frozen base + low-rank adapter), QLoRA (4-bit base + higher-precision adapter), the r·(d_in + d_out) parameter formula, distillation vs LoRA distinction (target vs parameters), response vs KL distillation, and gradient averaging across large global batches.

chapters.title: Cross-Model KV-Cache Transfer
chapters.summary: NVIDIA research on reusing a smaller related model's prefilled KV cache in a larger receiver through a pair-specific, closed-form ridge mapper: cross-layer source selection, RoPE-aware key mapping, limits, calibration cost, quality retention, and serving implications.

chapters.title: JEPA: Predicting Embeddings and Understanding Stopgrad
chapters.summary: JEPA and I-JEPA intuition, context encoder/predictor/target encoder, masked embedding prediction, loss notation, stopgrad forward and backward behavior with a numerical example and PyTorch detach, EMA target updates, and representation collapse.
